card.name: "at" after animal fetal-harm findings
card.fires_on: The word "at" (rarely "to") right after a fetal or developmental harm finding in animal reproduction studies, just before the exposure or dose level.

modes.label: at after fetal harm
modes.description: "at" follows an outcome such as embryolethality or malformations in animals and introduces the exposure or dose.
modes.example: administration of imetelstat to pregnant mice during the period of organogenesis resulted in embryo-fetal mortality<< at>> maternal exposures (AUC) 2

modes.label: to in animal dosing
modes.description: "to" appears after a drug given in feed to animals, just before the dose amount.
modes.example: Terazosin, administered in the feed<< to>> rats at doses of 8 mg/kg

card.plain: It fires on the small word that introduces the exposure or dose level after an animal study reports fetal harm.
